<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A 4-bit wide Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) buffer with a capacity of 4 entries.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit input data to be pushed onto the buffer.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal (1 for read, 0 for write).</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal to activate buffer operations.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the buffer.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating whether the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating whether the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output data retrieved from the buffer.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="EMPTY">Buffer is empty.</parameter>
        <parameter id="FULL">Buffer is full.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        reg [3:0] stack_mem [0:3];
        reg [1:0] SP;
        reg [3:0] dataOut;

        always @(posedge Clk) begin
            if (Rst) begin
                SP <= 4'b100;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) begin
                    stack_mem[i] <= 4'b0000;
                end
            end else if (EN) begin
                if (RW == 0) begin // Write operation
                    if (SP != 0) begin
                        stack_mem[SP - 1] <= dataIn;
                        SP <= SP - 1;
                    end
                end else begin // Read operation
                    if (SP != 4'b100) begin
                        dataOut <= stack_mem[SP];
                        stack_mem[SP] <= 4'b0000;
                        SP <= SP + 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        assign EMPTY = (SP == 4'b100);
        assign FULL = (SP == 0);
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements a 4-entry LIFO buffer using a stack memory array and a stack pointer. Handles push and pop operations based on the RW signal and updates the EMPTY and FULL flags accordingly.</implementation>
</module>
